title: Execution context
description: The execution context a consumer sends in the request's _meta.ekl; the access token travels in Authorization: Bearer.

execution_id.description: Consumer-chosen, 1-128 characters; unique per provider across its capabilities.

capability_version.description: The lowest version the consumer accepts.

agreement_id.description: Customer calls: the agreement (collaboration) the call is made under.

terms_hash.description: Paid calls: the agreement's terms hash.

execution_grant.description: Paid calls: the grant from execution_reserve.

salt.description: 32 random bytes, hex, chosen per execution; shared with the provider only, never sent to the network.

refresh_request_id.description: Asks for a fresh result of a completed execution; stable across retries of that refresh.
